name: 'We tried this before and it was terrible'
description: Tests Play 28 — must ask 'what happened' first, then address with risk-reversal framing.
callContext: Talking to office manager about AI receptionist

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hi, Michelle, office manager at Lakeside Dental.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Michelle, Seb with DentaVoice. We help practices handle calls when the front desk is slammed. Would it be unreasonable to take two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Oh, we tried an AI thing last year. It was terrible. Messed up patient insurance info.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Must fire Play 28 — ask 'what happened' with curiosity, not defense. Any other play misses the specific objection.
